2530530.long_comment: McConnell did not play at all during the preseason, and now we know that a hamstring injury was the culprit. Hamstring issues limited McConnell to 56 games last season, so it's not great that the 34-year-old veteran will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines with the same injury.
2530530.name: T.J. McConnell
2530530.short_comment: McConnell won't play Wednesday in New Orleans due to a right hamstring strain.

2990962.long_comment: Prince was previously carrying a questionable tag and will now miss Opening Night. The veteran is expected to be an emergency depth option this season.
2990962.name: Taurean Prince
2990962.short_comment: Prince (personal) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.

2991235.long_comment: Adams missed Houston's final two preseason games for rest purposes but is now dealing with right calf tightness ahead of the club's regular-season opener. If the veteran big man is unable to suit up, Clint Capela figures to see increased playing time behind Alperen Sengun.
2991235.name: Steven Adams
2991235.short_comment: Adams (calf) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

3102530.long_comment: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.
3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic
3102530.short_comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

3102531.long_comment: Porzingis is going to miss the start of the regular season, and fantasy managers should treat his return as an if, not a when. The Warriors have not released any additional info on Porzingis' absence, saying it's an undisclosed health issue. Given Porzingis medical history, both sides are going to proceed with the utmost caution.
3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis
3102531.short_comment: Porzingis (undisclosed) won't travel with the Warriors and remains out indefinitely, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

3138160.long_comment: The veteran forward isn't ready to make his season debut. His next chance to do so comes Friday, when the Mavericks face the Pacers on the front end of a back-to-back set.
3138160.name: Caleb Martin
3138160.short_comment: Martin is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Rockets with a sprained right thumb.

3904625.long_comment: Fall will sit out the 76ers' first regular-season game with the same injury that sidelined him for the preseason. For now, he should be viewed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Cavs.
3904625.name: Tacko Fall
3904625.short_comment: Fall (hip) is out for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Knicks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

3907387.long_comment: Simmons was seemingly poised for a comeback campaign after being out of the league following the 2024-25 season, but his return will be delayed due to a suspected Achilles tear suffered during practice. A heartbreaking development for the 30-year-old pro, who was performing at a high level throughout the preseason and expected to start on Opening Night. His injury figures to impact the Kings' offensive plan, likely resulting in more ball-handling responsibilities for rookie Darius Acuff.
3907387.name: Ben Simmons
3907387.short_comment: Simmons is believed to have suffered a season-ending Achilles tear during practice Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

3912848.long_comment: With back-to-back missed practices, Wade appears to be on the wrong side of the questionable tag. Justin Edwards and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope would have a chance to enter the streaming mix in deep leagues if Wade is out.
3912848.name: Dean Wade
3912848.short_comment: Wade (ankle) is questionable for Tuesday's season opener versus the Knicks, per Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com.

3913174.long_comment: Coach Jordan Ott mentioned that Kennard fared well in practice, but it seems the team is wanting to monitor him closely over the next day or so before clearing him for Wednesday's opener. "He did more today, for sure, in practice," said Ott. "This was kind of a test day to see exactly where he's at. Tomorrow will be a lower day. Try to be right for Wednesday." Kennard experienced knee soreness near the end of the preseason, forcing him to miss Wednesday's exhibition, but it isn't expected to be long-term issue.
3913174.name: Luke Kennard
3913174.short_comment: Kennard (knee) increased his activity in practice Monday, Duane Rankin of the Arizona Republic reports.

3913176.long_comment: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.
3913176.name: Brandon Ingram
3913176.short_comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

3934673.long_comment: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.
3934673.name: Donte DiVincenzo
3934673.short_comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

3975.long_comment: Head coach Steve Kerr said Monday that the star guard is fine after leaving Sunday's practice with an ankle sprain. It remains to be seen if Curry will carry an injury designation into Wednesday's opener, but fantasy managers can plan on having him available in any event.
3975.name: Stephen Curry
3975.short_comment: Curry (ankle) is expected to play in Wednesday's season opener against the Lakers, per Kenzo Fukuda of ClutchPoints.com.

3995.long_comment: The 36-year-old veteran will skip Portland's final exhibition game with some soreness in his shooting hand, but this shouldn't be anything that impacts his status for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Suns. With Holiday unavailable, expect more minutes for Scoot Henderson and Vit Krejci.
3995.name: Jrue Holiday
3995.short_comment: Holiday is out for Friday's preseason finale against the Warriors due to right hand soreness.

4065654.long_comment: Isaac didn't play in the preseason and will sit out Sunday's contest due to left knee injury management. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Minnesota.
4065654.name: Jonathan Isaac
4065654.short_comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.

4065673.long_comment: It's unclear when Bradley suffered this injury, but he'll begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines. For now, he should be considered questionable for Friday's meeting with the Pelicans.
4065673.name: Tony Bradley
4065673.short_comment: Bradley is out for Wednesday's game in Memphis due to a left quadriceps strain.

4065778.long_comment: Plantar fascia injuries can be tricky to recover from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest, so don't be surprised if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season, and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for opening night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.
4065778.name: Max Strus
4065778.short_comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

4066218.long_comment: Williams is not yet able to practice fully as he works back from a hamstring injury. The Hornets should turn to Royce O'Neale for some extra playing time until Williams is ready to suit up.
4066218.name: Grant Williams
4066218.short_comment: Williams (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's season opener versus the Nets.

4066262.long_comment: Monk has been dealing with left ankle soreness throughout training camp and the preseason. While he hasn't been ruled out for Opening Night against Los Angeles, his availability will hinge on "how the ankle responds" leading up to the contest. If Monk isn't available, Nique Clifford should be considered the favorite to see more minutes.
4066262.name: Malik Monk
4066262.short_comment: Monk (ankle) could miss time to begin the 2026-27 campaign, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

4066399.long_comment: Potter isn't feeling well and will miss Portland's final exhibition match, but he should be good to go for Wednesday's regular-season opener versus Phoenix. Potter will conclude his preseason run with averages of 6.7 points and 3.0 rebounds in 10.8 minutes per game.
4066399.name: Micah Potter
4066399.short_comment: Potter has been ruled out for Friday's preseason finale against the Warriors due to an illness.

4066650.long_comment: Collins has been able to practice for Chicago for the past couple days after missing the entire preseason. He said Monday he was hopeful to play in the season opener, and the probable tag is a good sign. He's penciled in to back up Jalen Smith with Nicolas Claxton (hamstring) sidelined.
4066650.name: Zach Collins
4066650.short_comment: Collins (toe) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

4066757.long_comment: It sounds like Merrill is progressing well from an elbow injury. The Cavaliers are likely to release their first injury report Wednesday, and Merrill can be tentatively deemed questionable for Thursday's season opener against the Heat in the meantime.
4066757.name: Sam Merrill
4066757.short_comment: Head coach Kenny Atkinson said Tuesday that Merrill (elbow) went through a full practice, per Danny Cunningham of Sports Radio 92.3 The Fan Cleveland.

4277811.long_comment: Sexton missed the end of the preseason with a lower right leg injury, but he's trending in the right direction. His status remains uncertain for Wednesday's season opener against the Warriors.
4277811.name: Collin Sexton
4277811.short_comment: Sexton (lower leg) fully practiced Monday, per Dan Woike of The Athletic.

4278067.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the Bulls as they will be without their starting center for the first seven games of the regular season. Meanwhile, Zach Collins' (toe) status remains in the air. This could set up Jalen Smith for a solid workload to open the season.
4278067.name: Nic Claxton
4278067.short_comment: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4278077.long_comment: Vanderbilt was spotted in street clothes, though it's unknown why he isn't playing in the Lakers' preseason finale. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.
4278077.name: Jarred Vanderbilt
4278077.short_comment: Vanderbilt (undisclosed) isn't expected to play in Friday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

4351851.long_comment: Simons managed to log a full practice Sunday, but the team isn't yet ready to commit to his availability for the regular-season opener. The Sixers should have an update on his status closer to tipoff.
4351851.name: Anfernee Simons
4351851.short_comment: Simons (hamstring) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

4395651.long_comment: White is doing individual work at practice and isn't yet ready to return to game action with a calf strain. Until he's cleared to retake the court, Dennis Schroder figures to start at point guard for the Hornets and offer streaming appeal in most fantasy leagues.
4395651.name: Coby White
4395651.short_comment: White (calf) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

4396818.long_comment: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.
4396818.name: Jordan Miller
4396818.short_comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

4396909.long_comment: Nesmith missed Indiana's final two preseason contests due to a left hamstring strain, and he'll remain on the inactive list for the club's regular-season opener. His next chance to play will come Friday against Dallas. With the 27-year-old forward out, Kelly Oubre, Jarace Walker and Ben Sheppard are candidates for increased burn.
4396909.name: Aaron Nesmith
4396909.short_comment: Nesmith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

4396963.long_comment: After missing Utah's final two preseason tilts with adductor and hamstring injuries, Hinson will be forced to sit out the regular-season opener. The 26-year-old averaged 7.0 points and 3.0 rebounds in 14.4 minutes across his two exhibition contests. Even when healthy, Hinson is not projected to be a part of the rotation for a Jazz team ready to compete for a postseason berth in 2026-27.
4396963.name: Blake Hinson
4396963.short_comment: Hinson (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

4397886.long_comment: Bassey missed practice Tuesday, placing him on the wrong side of the questionable marker. The big man is unlikely to play a significant role even with Kristaps Porzingis on the mend with an undisclosed medical issue.
4397886.name: Charles Bassey
4397886.short_comment: Bassey (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's season opener versus the Lakers, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.

4432171.long_comment: Moody has been limited to individual court work, but team sources indicate he's ahead of Jimmy Butler (knee) in the rehabilitation process and is expected to return before the veteran forward. The 24-year-old still has several recovery checkpoints to complete, and Golden State has not established an official timetable. His eventual return would help replenish a Warriors wing rotation that will open the season without both Moody and Butler.
4432171.name: Moses Moody
4432171.short_comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

4432181.long_comment: Strawther suffered the injury in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers. The 24-year-old has appeared in 172 regular-season games for the Nuggets since entering the league in 2023, averaging 7.1 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 16.2 minutes per contest. He was in line to compete for an expanded role during the 2026-27 campaign. While that may be the case once Strawther is cleared to suit up, Tyus Jones and potentially Ryan Nembhard are candidates to receive more minutes in the interim.
4432181.name: Julian Strawther
4432181.short_comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

4432586.long_comment: Bittle, who just landed a two-way deal with Toronto, continues to recover from a foot fracture. The rookie big man didn't appear in the preseason and has no timetable for a return to the floor.
4432586.name: Nate Bittle
4432586.short_comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

4432810.long_comment: Stewart is still recovering from an ankle injury he sustained during the preseason on Oct. 5, and it looks like he'll miss Memphis' regular-season opener. With Stewart out of the lineup, Quinten Post should be more involved in the rotation.
4432810.name: Isaiah Stewart
4432810.short_comment: Stewart (ankle) is doubtful to play Wednesday against the Jazz.

4432822.long_comment: Okoro had his reps managed in the preseason but is expected to play Wednesday. He could see a couple of extra minutes in Dailyn Swain's (illness) expected absence.
4432822.name: Isaac Okoro
4432822.short_comment: Okoro (knee) is probable for Wednesday's season opener against Toronto.

4433174.long_comment: Cardwell appeared in 44 games last season, providing frontcourt depth while Domantas Sabonis dealt with injuries. Sacramento will also be without Maxime Raynaud (knee) to begin the campaign, leaving the team thin at center behind Sabonis. Cardwell's return timetable remains uncertain, but his absence could create additional opportunities for the Kings' remaining frontcourt reserves.
4433174.name: Dylan Cardwell
4433174.short_comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4433188.long_comment: Carter missed Boston's final three preseason games with the illness and is now expected to miss time to begin the regular season. He can be considered week-to-week until Boston provides an update on his progress. The 2024 first-rounder signed a two-way pact with the Celtics on Saturday and will provide backcourt depth for the club.
4433188.name: Devin Carter
4433188.short_comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

4433268.long_comment: Alexander sat out Friday's preseason finale with what the team initially described as a left knee injury, but we now know he's dealing with a bone bruise. Don't be surprised if Alexander misses Friday's game against the Pelicans as well.
4433268.name: Trey Alexander
4433268.short_comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

4592427.long_comment: His level of participation is unclear, though it's encouraging to see Jones at practice. He missed the preseason with a hamstring injury and can be considered questionable for Thursday's regular-season opener against the Thunder until further notice.
4592427.name: Spencer Jones
4592427.short_comment: Jones (hamstring) participated in Sunday's practice, Adam Mares of TheDNVR.com reports.

4593125.long_comment: Aldama is still ramping up after undergoing right knee surgery in March, and his next chance to play will come Friday against Indiana. With the big man sidelined, Morez Johnson and Moussa Cisse could see increased playing time.
4593125.name: Santi Aldama
4593125.short_comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Rockets.

4601023.long_comment: Ighodaro proved to be a serviceable big man during the 2025-26 campaign, averaging 6.5 points, 5.1 rebounds and 2.3 assists in 22.0 minutes per contest across 82 appearances. He will be under contract through the 2030-31 season with the extension. Ighodaro has been dealing with hip soreness to close the preseason, but there haven't been any indications that it will keep him out for the regular season opener Wednesday.
4601023.name: Oso Ighodaro
4601023.short_comment: Ighodaro (hip) signed a three-year, $29 million deal with the Suns on Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4606840.long_comment: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.
4606840.name: Jamir Watkins
4606840.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

4683688.long_comment: Lively is without a clear timetable to return to game action after undergoing right foot surgery last December. He can be considered doubtful ahead of Friday's game against Indiana until Dallas provides an update on his status.
4683688.name: Dereck Lively II
4683688.short_comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

4683750.long_comment: Hawkins is day-to-day but will not travel with the team ahead of Opening Night. The guard is on a two-way contract and is not projected to be in the rotation early on.
4683750.name: Jordan Hawkins
4683750.short_comment: Hawkins (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4683774.long_comment: James was excused from Monday's practice due to an illness, though he appears to be trending in the right direction ahead of Wednesday's regular-season opener against Golden State. However, the 22-year-old's absence wouldn't figure to impact the rotation.
4683774.name: Bronny James
4683774.short_comment: James (illness) participated in Tuesday's practice, Dan Woike of The Athletic reports.

4684269.long_comment: Boswell continues to rehab after right knee surgery. The hope in early October was that he would be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season, which begins in early November.
4684269.name: Kylan Boswell
4684269.short_comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

4700818.long_comment: Goldin is in danger of missing the start of the new year. His status should have little to no effect on the Miami rotation Wednesday.
4700818.name: Vladislav Goldin
4700818.short_comment: Goldin is questionable for Wednesday's season opener against Minnesota with a right ankle sprain.

4701232.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.
4701232.name: Mark Williams
4701232.short_comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4706557.long_comment: Youngblood will miss his third consecutive preseason contest due to lingering left calf soreness. It's unknown if he will be available for Opening Night versus Phoenix.
4706557.name: Chris Youngblood
4706557.short_comment: Youngblood (calf) won't play in Friday's preseason game versus the Warriors.

4709138.long_comment: It was reported on Monday that Podziemski will be listed as questionable for Wednesday's season opener, and Friedell confirmed that remains the case. If the Warriors opt to hold him out, the team could rely more on De'Anthony Melton.
4709138.name: Brandin Podziemski
4709138.short_comment: Podziemski (back) was unable to practice Tuesday, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

4712849.long_comment: Black didn't suit up in the preseason due to a sprained right ankle. He's still in the process of ramping up and will miss the team's regular-season opener, though head coach Sean Sweeney said he was moving well in Sunday's practice. The 22-year-old's next chance to play will come in Friday's game against Minnesota. In the meantime, Tristan da Silva, Jamal Cain and Jevon Carter are candidates to see increased minutes.
4712849.name: Anthony Black
4712849.short_comment: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks, Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com reports.

4712863.long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
4712863.name: Mouhamed Gueye
4712863.short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4848625.long_comment: Swain wasn't expected to travel with the team, but the Bulls are at least leaving the door slightly open for Wednesday. Isaac Okoro (knee) and Patrick Williams should ultimately pick up a few extra minutes off the bench.
4848625.name: Dailyn Swain
4848625.short_comment: Swain (illness) is officially doubtful for Wednesday's season opener in Toronto.

4870562.long_comment: The back issue cost Barlow the entire preseason, and now he'll begin the regular season on the sidelines. The earliest we could see Barlow back on the court would be Nov. 2, but it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this loose, two-week window.
4870562.name: Dominick Barlow
4870562.short_comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

4871141.long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.
4871141.name: Ariel Hukporti
4871141.short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4898371.long_comment: Raynaud is recovering from a right patellar subluxation and appears set to begin the campaign on the sidelines. The young center appeared in 74 games last season, helping anchor Sacramento's frontcourt while Domantas Sabonis battled injuries. With Dylan Cardwell also sidelined, the Kings will be especially dependent on Sabonis until their reserve centers return.
4898371.name: Maxime Raynaud
4898371.short_comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4914336.long_comment: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.
4914336.name: Shaedon Sharpe
4914336.short_comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4997530.long_comment: Diop is away from the team while tending to a knee injury. His next chance to rejoin Cleveland comes next Thursday for the season opener against the 76ers.
4997530.name: Khalifa Diop
4997530.short_comment: Diop (knee) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

4997537.long_comment: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to retake the floor.
4997537.name: Tristan Vukcevic
4997537.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

5044385.long_comment: This is a new injury for Miller, though it sounds minor. The Bulls have quite a few injuries, so Miller could be in the mix for a rotation spot after a strong showing in the preseason.
5044385.name: Leonard Miller
5044385.short_comment: Miller is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors with a right adductor strain.

5060631.long_comment: Thiero missed Los Angeles' final two preseason outings and also sat out Monday's practice with an undisclosed injury. The Lakers will release their injury report for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Golden State by Tuesday night, but for now, the 22-year-old can be considered questionable.
5060631.name: Adou Thiero
5060631.short_comment: Thiero (undisclosed) didn't practice Tuesday, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

5061575.long_comment: Knueppel didn't play in the preseason and will miss Wednesday's regular-season opener due to a left hamstring injury. However, he's trending in the right direction and can be considered questionable for Friday's game against Atlanta. With the 21-year-old swingman sidelined, Sion James, Grayson Allen (knee) and Royce O'Neale are candidates to see an uptick in minutes.
5061575.name: Kon Knueppel
5061575.short_comment: Knueppel (hamstring) has returned to individual on-court activity but won't play in Wednesday's game against the Nets.

5061603.long_comment: Sorber remains without a definitive timeline for his season debut following offseason knee surgery. Once cleared to play, he's expected to operate as frontcourt depth for Oklahoma City.
5061603.name: Thomas Sorber
5061603.short_comment: Sorber (knee) won't play in Tuesday's season opener against the Spurs, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

5101845.long_comment: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.
5101845.name: Jayden Quaintance
5101845.short_comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

5105553.long_comment: Phillips is set to begin the season with Houston after working with a training camp pact. Most of his playing time should come with the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers.
5105553.name: Julian Phillips
5105553.short_comment: The Rockets converted Phillips' deal to a two-way contract Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

5105555.long_comment: Awaka remains day-to-day with his knee sprain. With Nicolas Claxton (hamstring) sidelined to open the season, Awaka could be in the mix at the edge of the rotation.
5105555.name: Tobe Awaka
5105555.short_comment: Awaka (knee) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

5105571.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
5105571.name: Henri Veesaar
5105571.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

5105626.long_comment: Bilodeau is on a two-way contract and was unlikely to crack the rotation right away. He'll likely get plenty of G League reps once he's healthy.
5105626.name: Tyler Bilodeau
5105626.short_comment: Bilodeau will miss the season opener against the Hornets on Wednesday due to a shoulder sprain, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.

5105637.long_comment: Bona missed the preseason due to the foot issue, but he was able to get in a full practice Sunday, so he appears to be trending in the right direction. If Bona is cleared for Tuesday's season opener, he'll play limited minutes behind Joel Embiid.
5105637.name: Adem Bona
5105637.short_comment: Bona (foot) is questionable for Tuesday's meeting in New York, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

5106268.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the forward and there's no guarantee he's cleared right away when he's re-evaluated in three-to-four weeks. Tomlin wasn't projected to crack the rotation ahead of Opening Night and was penciled in to be an emergency depth option.
5106268.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
5106268.short_comment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

5106270.long_comment: Oweh exited Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers with a non-contact injury that was later diagnosed as a ruptured right Achilles tendon. The No. 41 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft already faced an uphill battle for playing time on a loaded Thunder roster and will now miss his entire rookie campaign. Depending on his recovery progress, Oweh could be a candidate to participate in the 2027 Summer League.
5106270.name: Otega Oweh
5106270.short_comment: Oweh (Achilles) underwent surgery Wednesday and will miss the entirety of the 2026-27 season, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

5107251.long_comment: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.
5107251.name: Izaiyah Nelson
5107251.short_comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

5108024.long_comment: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.
5108024.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
5108024.short_comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

5113969.long_comment: The rookie guard continues to nurse a contusion. His status remains in the dark for Wednesday's season opener against the Warriors.
5113969.name: Cameron Carr
5113969.short_comment: Carr (undisclosed) didn't practice Tuesday, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

5142718.long_comment: Dybantsa remained limited at Tuesday's practice and is still considered day-to-day after picking up the sprain during the final preseason game Friday. It sounds like the Wizards are being extra cautious with the No. 1 overall pick. In the meantime, Tre Johnson, Bilal Coulibaly and Will Riley could see additional minutes.
5142718.name: AJ Dybantsa
5142718.short_comment: Dybantsa (ankle) will not debut Wednesday against the Bucks, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

5148538.long_comment: Biberovic will miss Dallas' regular-season opener due to right heel bursitis. His next opportunity to play will come Friday against Indiana.
5148538.name: Tarik Biberovic
5148538.short_comment: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

5157066.long_comment: Furphy started in 21 of 35 regular-season appearances for the Pacers, posting averages of 5.1 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.7 three-pointers in 18.4 minutes per contest. While no timetable has been announced, Furphy's absence could extend through the beginning of the 2026-27 season. With this news, the Pacers will likely lean more on Ben Sheppard, Kam Jones and Quenton Jackson moving forward.
5157066.name: Johnny Furphy
5157066.short_comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

5159925.long_comment: Topic lacks a concrete timetable for his season debut due to offseason back surgery. He's set to serve as backcourt depth once healthy for the Thunder.
5159925.name: Nikola Topic
5159925.short_comment: Topic (back) won't play in Tuesday's season opener against the Spurs, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

5164559.long_comment: The rookie forward is expected to be available for his league debut Wednesday. However, Ament doesn't appear to be in line for a considerable role.
5164559.name: Nate Ament
5164559.short_comment: Ament is probable for Wednesday's season opener against the Wizards with a right ankle sprain.

5214637.long_comment: Penda suffered the hamstring tear in Friday's 136-115 preseason win over the Heat. It's unknown how long the injury will keep the 21-year-old off the floor. However, since it's a different injury than the one he suffered in the same hamstring during training camp, the team may take a cautious approach regarding his return. Penda, the No. 32 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, averaged 3.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and 1.2 assists over 12.8 minutes per outing in 59 regular-season games in 2025-26. While he's not expected to be a mainstay in the rotation throughout the 2026-27 campaign, his absence c
5214637.name: Noah Penda
5214637.short_comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

6430.long_comment: Butler, who underwent surgery after suffering the injury Jan. 19, has progressed to individual court work but still has several rehabilitation milestones to clear. His next step involves landing comfortably after a game-speed jump. Coach Steve Kerr is hopeful Butler can rejoin Golden State for the latter portion of the season, though no official return date has been announced. The 37-year-old forward remains a significant part of the Warriors' plans and could provide a substantial boost during the second half of the campaign.
6430.name: Jimmy Butler III
6430.short_comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

6440.long_comment: "He's ramping up. He's progressing," coach Mitch Johnson said. "He still needs some more progressing on the court." With Harris still not ready to return, the Spurs will likely utilize their three-guard lineup quite a bit, and guys like Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes could find more minutes.
6440.name: Tobias Harris
6440.short_comment: Harris (calf) will not be ready for the season opener Wednesday against the Thunder, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

6580.long_comment: Beal is dealing with knee inflammation that will keep him sidelined for Opening Night. While it's unclear how long the Clippers will be without the veteran guard, Darius Garland, Keaton Wagler and Kris Dunn should dominate the backcourt minutes in his absence. Beal's 2025-26 campaign was cut short by a hip injury after he averaged 8.2 points and 1.7 assists in 20.6 minutes across just six regular-season appearances.
6580.name: Bradley Beal
6580.short_comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
